notes.title: The Symbiant II demo now with additional scenes!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42830109/6a4d1f21336c03da66f88df7d5e7834172671c8d.png[/img]
The Symbiant II's demo now contains 7 scenes! Meet Cyn Deh, and decide whether Varga gets Rhodias to come to the temple amiably, or if Rhodias will need some extra convincing...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42830109/393172a9e3d3c0c53adc5b1f2cb7a5c1ef545c70.png[/img]
